title: New Mailbox Feature
mainText: Now users can view the latest application updates here in the mailbox. Stay tuned for more updates!

title: Society Leaders Added
mainText: Users can now view leaders of particular societies in the leaderboard. Check out who's leading in your favorite societies!

title: Quiz Titans Section Added
mainText: Users can also view quiz titans, i.e., leaders on a particular article. Test your knowledge and compete with others!
